title: Choose the visual world for crypz
question: The roll assigned Trade Mosaic. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Trade Mosaic
options.thesis: Every closed position is one square pixel; your history becomes your own punk.
options.viewport: Shell with left rail; equity strip on top; the 333-cell mosaic beside the edge readout; chart slot below.
options.risk: Mosaic turns decorative if cells stop linking to real trades.

raised.raise: Fixed-cell numerals: every figure set in fixed tabular cells; digits roll per-character on period change.
Hairline state marks: focus is a bracket, pressed is filled, no radius anywhere.
Corridor focus: picking an instrument lights it across mosaic, breakdown and table; everything else dims.
One reserved colour per job: green/red only for PnL sign, white only for the active selection.

options.label: Block Explorer Ledger
options.thesis: Your trades read like confirmed blocks: heights, hashes, a ledger you can audit.
options.viewport: Top bar; a row of recent 'blocks' (days) as stacked tiles; ledger stats; chart; table as tx list.
options.risk: Familiar: most crypto dashboards borrow the explorer look.

options.label: Catalog Sleeve
options.lineage: Factory Records / Saville sleeves, Unknown Pleasures
options.thesis: Daily PnL drawn as a stacked white pulse plot on matte black; every trade carries a catalog number.
options.viewport: Ridgeline of daily PnL owns the top; catalog numbers index trades; stats in small caps beneath.
options.case: Wins audience identification (the mysterious crypto guy); loses on clarity because coded labels slow reading.
options.risk: Coded labels fight a review tool; must decode everything on screen.

options.label: Split-flap Concourse
options.thesis: Positions as departures on a clacking board.
options.viewport: Board of rows ranked by close time.
options.case: Loses both: not the crypto trader's world, and a board hides the edge breakdown.
options.kept: Fixed-cell numerals that roll per digit.

options.label: Centre-rail Reference
options.thesis: Twin columns around a keyed rail.
options.viewport: Two text columns, rail of keys.
options.case: Loses both: a reading form on a working screen; bone and vermilion break the black/white brief.

options.label: Midnight Transit Diagram
options.case: Loses both: four-line rainbow breaks the monochrome brief, and the map metaphor is a stretch.

options.label: Orienteering Map
options.case: Loses both: no tie to the audience, light terrain fights the scene.

options.label: Streaming Title Wall
options.case: Loses both: browse-and-pick model hides numbers behind focus.
options.kept: Active row lifts, rest dims (folded into corridor focus).

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: An exchange-style dark dashboard (OKX/Binance account pages) on shadcn, executed cleanly.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar, KPI card row, chart card, positions table.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the exchanges you already use.
